assertions.head_surface: strainer
assertions.tail_surface: consider a strainer on the suction side of a positive displacement pump
assertions.evidence_text: It is always good practice to consider a strainer on the suction side of a positive displacement pump. The strainer will keep foreign objects from going into the pump.

assertions.head_surface: pressure relief device
assertions.tail_surface: Provide a pressure relief device in any part of a pump and piping system that can be valved off and, thus, completely isolated
assertions.evidence_text: Provide a pressure relief device in any part of a pump and piping system that can be valved off and, thus, completely isolated.

assertions.head_surface: relief valve
assertions.tail_surface: mounting one in the discharge line
conditions: If the pump is not equipped with a relief valve
assertions.evidence_text: If the pump is not equipped with a relief valve, consideration should be given to mounting one in the discharge line.

assertions.head_surface: foot valve
assertions.tail_surface: at the end of the suction piping
conditions: When pumping a light liquid with a suction lift
assertions.evidence_text: When pumping a light liquid with a suction lift, a foot valve at the end of the suction piping or a check valve in the first horizontal run will hold the liquid in the line and make it easier for the pump to prime.

assertions.head_surface: check valve
conditions: When pumping a light liquid with a suction lift
assertions.evidence_text: When pumping a light liquid with a suction lift, a foot valve at the end of the suction piping or a check valve in the first horizontal run will hold the liquid in the line and make it easier for the pump to prime.

assertions.head_surface: pipe sealer
assertions.tail_surface: All joints of the piping system should be tight; pipe sealer will help assure leak-free threaded joints
assertions.evidence_text: All joints of the piping system should be tight; pipe sealer will help assure leak-free threaded joints.

assertions.head_surface: bypass should be built around the strainer, or two strainers should be put in parallel with proper valving so they can be isolated for cleaning
assertions.evidence_text: If the pump operates continuously, a bypass should be built around the strainer, or two strainers should be put in parallel with proper valving so they can be isolated for cleaning.

assertions.head_surface: Loops, expansion joints, or unsecured (this does not mean unsupported) runs should be used
conditions: When piping a hot or cold system (liquid being handled is at a temperature different from the air surrounding the pump)
assertions.evidence_text: When piping a hot or cold system (liquid being handled is at a temperature different from the air surrounding the pump), be sure allowance is made for expansion and contraction of the piping. Loops, expansion joints, or unsecured (this does not mean unsupported) runs should be used so the pump casing is not distorted.
